chars.STEPHEN: STEPHEN: a 32-year-old white man with short dark hair and a neat dark beard, wearing a black hoodie with one bright lime-green stripe across the chest, grey joggers, a black gaming headset around his neck
chars.MOTHER: MOTHER: a woman in her late fifties with short grey bob hair, wearing a burgundy knitted cardigan over a cream blouse
chars.FATHER: FATHER: a bald man in his sixties with round glasses and a grey moustache, wearing a navy wool jumper
chars.DETECTIVE: DETECTIVE: a female police detective in her forties with a blonde ponytail, wearing a long beige trench coat over a white shirt, police badge on her belt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Cosy living room of a small terraced house in Northern Ireland, winter evening. STEPHEN sits on the sofa with his hand on the shoulder of the crying MOTHER while the FATHER stares at the floor, a framed photo of a smiling young woman with long brown hair on the side table, Christmas decorations, sad heavy mood

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Dark bedroom gaming setup at night, STEPHEN wearing his headset sits at a desk in front of a glowing monitor and a microphone, calmly playing a video game as if nothing happened, blue and purple screen light on his face, Christmas lights on the wall

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Outside a small brick house at night in winter, STEPHEN stands on the doorstep holding a phone to his ear, panicked expression, calling the police, cold breath visible, wet street with orange street lamps

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: STEPHEN sits on the edge of his bed at night typing a long sad message on his smartphone, screen glow on his face, new year fireworks visible through the window behind him, melancholic mood

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: STEPHEN sits alone on the floor of a dim bedroom leaning against the bed, head in his hands, rain on the window, empty bottles nearby, lonely and broken mood

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: STEPHEN stands at a rainy window in a dark room holding a framed photo of a smiling young woman with long brown hair, looking down at it with a blank unreadable face, grey winter light

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: STEPHEN in his gaming chair with headset on, laughing loudly at the monitor while playing a game, bright colorful screen light, energy drink cans on the desk, strange cheerful mood that feels unsettling

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Wet residential street at dawn in a small Northern Ireland town, the DETECTIVE walks with determination toward a brick terraced house followed by two uniformed police officers, police cars with blue lights parked behind them

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the narrow hallway of a house, a uniformed officer handcuffs STEPHEN who looks shocked, while the DETECTIVE in front of him holds up a laptop showing a paused video game stream, tense dramatic moment, blue police light from the open door
